scope: All prepared terminology candidate-to-DSLD occurrence combinations plus bounded NatMed subject-link proposals; source topics remain separate

rules.M1: Carry prior evidence-backed decisions only for the same source occurrence, target and pinned source files; retain original review references
rules.M2: High denotes_concept only for a single returned active RxNorm/MeSH target with an exact case/whitespace-normalized preferred name and no unresolved botanical/blend preparation scope
rules.M3: Medium when names need an unreviewed synonym bridge, alternatives remain, target is inactive, preparation scope is unresolved or PubChem exact material identity lacks reviewed support
rules.M4: Low exact-match confidence for explicit hydrochloride-versus-hydrate conflicts or unsupported allergenic-extract preparation; other relationships are not invented
rules.M5: No returned target is unresolved/no_candidate with null confidence, not Low or evidence of absence
rules.M6: NatMed exact general-ingredient name supports related_ingredient_subject only; group-only or qualified preparations stay Medium unless separately reviewed
rules.M7: Reddit literal and inherited topics are source-context links, not ingredient identity or clinical evidence

boundaries: Confidence is in a specified relationship, not clinical truth
No fuzzy matching, punctuation removal, inferred chemical conversion or population/dose propagation
No new exact-material links without prior explicit scope review
Do not update the graph in Step 3
eligibility: High eligible for later construction at its stated relation; Medium pending; Low excludes exact matching only. This is rule-based triage, not exhaustive human validation.
